title: Plan durable purchases around need and maintainability
summary: Before buying, check whether the item is needed, how it will be maintained, and whether repair or spare parts are available.
content:
For a planned durable-goods purchase, write down the need and compare products using information that applies to the exact model. Review warranty terms, repair options, spare-parts availability, and operating requirements where relevant.

Energy labels apply only to covered products and the exact labelled model. Do not infer efficiency from appearance or assume a higher purchase price will be recovered through savings without usage, tariff, and product-specific data.
implementation_steps: Write down the item and intended use
Compare model-specific labels and warranty details where applicable
Save the actual purchase price and product details if you want a later comparison
limitations: Product labels and standards vary by category
This guide does not calculate lifecycle cost or environmental impact
